svg.title: Боковые выпады с гирей — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Lateral lunge holding one kettlebell in goblet grip at chest. Front view. LEFT figure upright, feet about hip-width apart. RIGHT figure has stepped sideways toward image LEFT with one foot, visibly bending that knee over the stepped foot and sitting hips backward toward that bent leg. Opposite leg remains visibly straight and points laterally with heel planted. Show unmistakably asymmetric knee flexion, one leg straight and one bent, rather than a wide symmetric squat. Same single kettlebell remains at chest. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
